skills_considered.reason: The discovery ledger is owned by other batches; the corrections this reading supports are proposed as commit candidates and in the intake note.
A clinical genotype-phenotype source supplies no therapeutic lever for the reference genotype class; forging hypotheses from it would manufacture a lead.
No compound is tested with a measured outcome beyond clinical anecdote; nothing to send to BLOCK-1 triage.
Scientists do not touch the four current files; every change is proposed as a commit candidate.
The triples are published in the candidates for a blind auditor; the reader cannot audit their own locators.

group_assessment.weighting: A single-centre medical-genetics and paediatric-neurology group reporting a diagnostic-yield cohort; the WWOX content is two table rows. Credible for genotype and syndrome label; carries no phenotype depth. Not a per-author sweep: weighting rests on the paper's own design.

field_density.note: PubMed indexes one record under the allele name; the three reports of homozygous p.L239R known to this reading (this cohort, PMID 42092735, PMID 30094525) are found by reading, not by search.
